CWE-79.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
CWE-79.remediation: Context-aware output encoding, strict Content-Security-Policy (CSP), and input validation.

CWE-89.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
CWE-89.remediation: Use parameterized queries (prepared statements), ORM abstractions, and stored procedures.

CWE-639.name: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key ('Insecure Direct Object Reference - IDOR')
CWE-639.remediation: Implement record-level authorization checks validating current user session against the requested object ID.

CWE-918.name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
CWE-918.remediation: Enforce strict allowlists of remote domains/IPs, block private IP ranges (RFC 1918), and disable unnecessary URI schemes.

CWE-22.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
CWE-22.remediation: Use strict path normalization, verify resolved paths reside within the designated root directory, or use indirect file keys.

CWE-200.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
CWE-200.remediation: Remove stack traces from production error responses, restrict access to backup files and config endpoints.

CWE-942.name: Permissive Cross-origin Resource Sharing Policy
CWE-942.remediation: Avoid returning 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' with 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true'. Validate Origin headers against a strict whitelist.

CWE-16.name: Configuration
CWE-16.remediation: Enforce security hardening baselines, remove default credentials, and set protective HTTP headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options).
